name: Mitico Fleuretty
source:
A demon who made a contract with Annerose. In layman's terms, she is a being from another dimension.
Normally, she is a beautiful and bewitching maid, but when Annerose goes out, she transforms into a sloth.
Her real name is Fleuretty, but Annerose finds it difficult to call her, so she is called "Michiko". She also likes it and calls herself Michiko.

She loves Annerose in a lesbian way and thinks that a man is not suitable for Annerose at all.
As a newcomer and a man, the main character is nothing but an obstacle to her, so she plays tricks (that would kill a normal person) on him at every opportunity.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
